mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_tokens (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_tokens SET consumed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE password_reset_tokens SET consumed_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
